## What is this about?

<!-- generated by aider + aider-skills + skill create-blog-entry-what-is-this-about -->
The repository provides a set of software architecture skills and reference material that help teams design robust systems. It includes concise explanations of common architectural patterns, trade‑off discussions, and practical examples that illustrate how to apply them. The content is organized by topic, making it easy to find guidance on areas such as microservices, domain‑driven design, and performance optimization. It is intended for software engineers, architects, and technical leads who want to improve their architectural decision‑making and adopt proven practices.
